prompts.keysA:
Use case: style-transfer / whole-body frame animation.
Create a production 2D game animation sprite sheet, exactly FOUR whole-body drawings in an evenly spaced TWO BY TWO grid on genuinely transparent alpha background, preferably 1536x1536. Each cell contains ONE entire right-facing running character, generous transparent margins, no labels, floor, shadows, effects or guides.
REFERENCE 1 is the exact CHARACTER MODEL and palette: copy its side-profile identity and proportions. REFERENCE 2 is the original Warrior RUN FRAMES 1,2,3,4 (reading order) and is ONLY a motion-pose reference. Redraw each respective pose as our ivory paper character, not the warrior. Replace ALL head/face/shoulders/torso/arms/hands/legs/feet/clothing. NO warrior hair, armor, sword, boots or colors. Keep the original pose sequence, which changes every frame.
CHARACTER: very large round ivory head, ONE small black oval eye near front/right of head, absolutely no mouth/nose/hair/ears. Compact small torso, short arms and legs, overall neutral standing height 2.35 heads. The head stays same size/shape in all four images. Warm body/head/hands/bare shins/feet #E8DDCB; long flowing paper cloak AND visible plain SHORTS both same muted warm ivory #D1C7B7, only about10% darker than body, NOT gray-black pants. Shorts have two separate little leg openings above knees, no stripes or seam decoration. Keep shorts visible below the wrapping front cloak. Short rounded hands and feet.
Long broad paper cloak wraps whole front and sides at shoulder, with broad overlapping front panel and TWO long rear tails flowing LEFT behind the running body. Reference side-view design faithfully. Hems smooth and rounded, soft folds, NOT spikes/feathers/tiny layers/scarf. Matte softly painted paper surface, broad gentle shading, subtle grain, no photorealism or plastic, no pixelation.
ACTION: compact low forward lean, readable leg motion below cloak. Frame1 TOP LEFT: near leg stretched backward/down in final toe push, far thigh forward/up, far shin folded back under body, near arm bent forward; broad split stride. Frame2 TOP RIGHT: both feet airborne, near trailing leg releases ground and starts folding, far thigh drives further forward, bent far knee high, same arm swing continues. Frame3 BOTTOM LEFT: far leg unfolds down-forward for contact, near heel curls up behind, near arm near forward extreme. Frame4 BOTTOM RIGHT: far foot planted under front of pelvis, knee compresses to accept weight, near folded leg swings underneath body toward next step; lowest body pose. Follow the source image's actual limb gesture/ordering within our short-legged proportions, not long realistic anatomy. Near leg slightly more lit than far, but BOTH ivory bare legs with ivory shorts; distinguish depth gently.
Keep identical scale, palette, head size, side view, eye placement, cloak construction throughout. Head remains stable with only slight body bounce; cloak tips smoothly follow inertia through the four poses. Four DISTINCT complete drawings, not four copies, not dismembered parts, not diagram. No extra limbs. Every whole sprite fits within its own quarter of sheet, with clear separation.
